actions.action: Calculate all six plans for stated usage
actions.mechanism: Evaluate usage against included allowances and charge rules before presenting comparable totals.
actions.implementation: Ask for storage, editors, guests, and exports—not income. Calculate mandatory add-ons and overages for all six plans on one billing basis.
actions.check: Fixture-test allowance boundaries and add-on dependencies; displayed totals must match independently calculated expectations. Mark unsupported usage explicitly.
actions.risk: Unspecified usage must produce an incomplete estimate, not a misleading total.

actions.action: Separate required costs from optional purchases
actions.mechanism: Explicit charge categories prevent required add-ons from appearing elective and optional extras from appearing unavoidable.
actions.implementation: Show base price, required additions, selected optional extras, and total separately. Leave optional extras unchecked; explain each requirement using stated usage.
actions.check: Toggle each optional extra: only its cost and dependent charges should change. Required charges must remain included and labeled.
actions.risk: Dependencies can make an otherwise optional purchase require additional charges.

actions.action: Align capabilities in an accessible comparison table
actions.mechanism: Consistent rows expose differences that similar headline prices conceal, without requiring visitors to remember separate cards.
actions.implementation: Keep all six plans visible with semantic headers. Include allowance, required-add-on, optional-extra, and unavailable labels for every capability; never rely on color.
actions.check: Give visitors two similarly priced plans and fixed usage; ask which supports it, each total, and which charges are optional.
actions.risk: Wide tables need keyboard-accessible scrolling and preserved screen-reader header associations.

actions.action: Preview costs when usage crosses a limit
actions.mechanism: Boundary previews reveal cost jumps and capability ceilings hidden by a single usage estimate.
actions.implementation: Offer a user-controlled usage increment. Display current and revised totals for all six plans, naming triggered charges or newly unsupported requirements.
actions.check: Test immediately below, at, and above every allowance boundary; verify totals and availability against structured rules using keyboard and screen reader.
actions.risk: Label previews as hypothetical scenarios, not predicted usage or affordability advice.
